description: Single-Spark MOSS-VL-Realtime 11B session-replay job using the exact d1f71a58 BF16 snapshot. It preserves the bounded MP4-plus-JSONL contract and adopts upstream cached-vision RoPE, preprocessing, system-prompt, and per-sample batched-vision fixes. It does not expose the upstream interactive WebSocket, camera, or screen-capture service. Physical Spark acceptance remains pending.
title: MOSS-VL-Realtime 11B BF16 native single Spark
